Filter long aggregates data.table rows by pillar and/or dimension

Source: R/spi-filters.R
filter_rows_by_pillar_dimension.Rd

Filters the source_id column in the aggregates long-format data.table. When both pillar and dimension are provided, dimension (more specific) takes precedence.

filter_rows_by_pillar_dimension(dt, pillar, dimension)

Arguments

dt

A data.table (long format, from SPI_databank_country_and_aggregates.csv).

pillar

Integer 1–5, or NULL.

dimension

Character string in "P.D" format, or NULL.

Value

A filtered data.table.
